_note: Adjudications for sweep batch 04 (2026-07-24 to 2026-08-01). Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

reviews.note: Puts a five-month window on the turnaround and moves it from finances to marriages and children.
Seasonal banter in prayer.
Anointing children for the school year.
Claims a January origin and treats the Kushner reporting a fortnight later as confirmation.
Adds the Trump flag and dates the vision to 9 or 30 January; he corrects himself on the date mid-sentence, so treat 30 January as the firmer one.
He asserts the causal link himself, disaster following a Holy Land deal, so it is recorded as his causation rather than inferred.
Also the only place he numbers the Senate exposure: three seats they are trying to flip.
Japan aftershocks and temple rubble offered as running fulfilment; the UK antisemitism figure belongs with antisemitism-peak.
The hardest version of this claim: organised election interference run through Detroit mosques in November. Scoreable 30 Nov 2026.
England drought sits in the same passage and belongs with england-drought if it recurs.
Generalises the rule: birthing pains step up at every fall feast, not just this one.
An IT outage is not a cyber attack; he treats the ground stop as fulfilment of the 25 June word, which overstates the match.
Explicit accuracy claim attached to the same event.
States the mechanism as judgment on false religion and makes the temple collapses a deliberate sign.
Puts a six to seven month bound on the 25th amendment risk, expiring end of February 2027.
Names a living person as the Antichrist, which is the most specific and most consequential identification in the corpus.
Frames the reprieve as a test put to the church rather than a promise, which makes a bad outcome attributable to them.
Keeps the 2030 horizon and adds a three-year watch window.
Also records a prior prayer target he counts as met, that Trump outlast Usha Vance's pregnancy.
A claimed hit on a new prime minister, but he never names the country and the clip is not transcribed. Unattachable.
Turkey-Iraq energy alliance as fulfilment, plus the five o'clock shadow identification he says predates the man's election.
The fifty-yard Jericho march is a new, specific practice.
Timing aside with no stated subject.
Visual detail given before the reporting: fence, stealth helicopter, groups of men. Worth checking the February clip against the record.
He flags himself that it sounds like science fiction, which is a rare self-hedge on a war claim.
Fixes the golf course vision to 30 January.
Played Trump clip on the ballroom.
One-week horizon, already past due as of 29 Aug 2026. Needs evidence.
A self-scored miss on the 17 July weather word. Kept unattached on purpose: it is evidence about his hit rate, not a claim.
Dated to 28 July 2026 and past due.
A Selective Service mobilisation exercise is the closest thing to concrete draft evidence in the corpus.
Narrows to one or two weeks out.
Assassination line and a European October 7th plot are bundled with a Saudi deployment; unclear which subject the assassination refers to.
Devotional prayer.
Adds organ harvesting and, unusually, an explicit refusal to date it, so it cannot expire.
Adds animal DNA hybrids and locates the labs in America, Japan and Asia.
Moves the conversion claim from American megachurches to English parish churches, with a 2026 map.
Exact date given, 24 September 2026, so it is cheap to score.
Dates the underlying word to February and adds the three-site detail.
Sets a hard read-out date: the first week of November.
Runs against fair-election-2026 and the Byron landslide. He offers his own disqualification test if a big red wave lands, so both branches are on the record.
Remnant prospers while the shaking runs; close to the revival claim but framed as personal exemption rather than national revival.
A crash is assumed rather than predicted here; the content is his posture toward it.
